name: @projexlight/sdk-semantic
summary: Semantic layer for ProjexCloud (G9 closer): per-tenant Ontology (Object Types + Relation Types) + SemanticIntent (plain-English → query plan) + SemanticPolicy (allow / deny / reshape rules) + CapabilityGraph cross-domain bridges. The translation + safety layer that lets non-SQL users ask questions of the platform without bypassing tenant security. Cloud-builder + analytics blueprints rely on this.

events.name: semantic.ontology.published.v1
events.description: New ontology version published; carries diff vs. prior version.

events.name: semantic.intent.resolved.v1
events.description: Plain-English intent translated into a query plan; carries plan_hash + chosen ontology version.

events.name: semantic.policy.decision.v1
events.description: Policy evaluated against an intent: allow / deny / reshape. Carries the reshape diff if applicable.

events.name: semantic.capability.registered.v1
events.description: MCP capability registered into the cross-domain graph (FR-SEM-9 / G9).

models.description: Per-tenant ontology version: name, version, definition_blob, published_at.
Relation-type definition (e.g. 'invoice belongs_to customer'); cardinality + traversal cost.
Cross-domain bridge: MCP capability ↔ ontology object/relation. Used by the AI gateway to translate intents to concrete tool calls.
Resolved plan: ontology version, plan steps, estimated cost.
Per-tenant policy rule: match predicate, decision (allow / deny / reshape), reason template.
Cross-domain mappings (e.g. CRM lead ↔ Marketing campaign) needed for cross-vertical queries.

hooks.name: publishOntology
hooks.description: Publish a new ontology version. Versions are pinned per intent so intents resolved against an old version stay reproducible.

hooks.name: registerCapability
hooks.description: Register an MCP capability into the cross-domain graph (FR-SEM-9 closer for G9).

hooks.name: resolveIntent
hooks.description: Translate plain-English intent to a query plan. Includes ontology lookup + policy evaluation in one pass.

hooks.name: evaluatePolicy
hooks.description: Standalone policy evaluation; useful for the cloud-builder agent to pre-check whether an intent would be allowed before executing.

scenarios.title: Tenant publishes their canonical Customer + Invoice ontology
scenarios.when_to_use: First-time semantic setup. Tenant declares 'Customer' and 'Invoice' as object types + their relations.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Ontology v1.0.0 published. Future intents resolve against this version; older intents still resolve against whatever they were pinned to.

scenarios.title: Resolve 'show me top 10 customers by MRR last quarter'
scenarios.when_to_use: Cloud-builder or business-user query surface. SemanticIntent translates English → ontology-grounded plan.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Plan + policy decision returned. Caller runs the plan through sdk-analytics.federatedQuery. Audit chain has intent + plan + decisions for full reproducibility.

scenarios.title: SemanticPolicy reshapes a too-broad query
scenarios.when_to_use: User asks 'show me every customer's payment-method last4'. Policy refuses to surface PII even if the user's role would permit raw access — reshapes to anonymized cohorts.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Caller gets a useful (anonymized) answer rather than a 'denied'. SemanticPolicy logs the reshape decision so an auditor can review.

scenarios.title: Register an MCP tool into the cross-domain graph
scenarios.when_to_use: G9 closer (FR-SEM-9). When sdk-mcp-bridge installs a new MCP server, it tells the semantic layer about the tool's capabilities so cross-domain intents can route to them.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Capability_graph_edge written. Future cloud-builder intents that ask 'find a way to do X' can be routed to the MCP tool via the bridge.

scenarios.title: Strict mode refuses ambiguous intents with an explanation
scenarios.when_to_use: Highly-regulated tenant (b2b-analytics blueprint with semantic_layer_strictness='strict-with-explanation'). Unknown column → refuse with a helpful error rather than guess.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Caller receives a deny + explanation + suggested rephrasings. Better failure mode than guessing wrong + returning a misleading number.

compliance_posture.notes: Every intent's resolution carries the ontology version + the policy decision trace — the EU AI Act decision-logic transparency requirement is met because any AI-driven answer routed through here can be replayed from the same plan. SemanticPolicy is the GDPR Art-22 lever for automated-decision auditability.

pricing_skus.unit_description: per intent resolved (cached intents billed at lower rate)
